# Botany There are some new tools for botanists to enjoy.
## Seed Splicer
Unlocked with a specific research, seed splicing allows you to get a new type of seed by combining two other seeds.
Note: seed order matters here - for example, wheat seed in slot 1 and apple seed in slot 2 might have a different outcome than wheat seed in slot 2 and apple seed in slot 1.
